== Description ==

[[Ming Huo]] (right, short dark hair, dark grey tee, name tag, green bottle on the table) and [[Kyle Krueger]] (left, shaved head, beard, dark long-sleeve, looking at the board) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
